Alma Better College vs Chanakya University for M.Sc compares a recorded 2023 placement on the Alma Better side with Chanakya University's official 2026-27 M.Sc Psychology fee. Chanakya has no M.Sc placement row here.

sections.heading: Alma Better College vs Chanakya University for M.Sc: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Alma Better College if you want the only placement record on this page, from 2023, at an average of ₹5 lakh and a highest of ₹14 lakh, listed against M.Sc in Computer Science Software Engineering. Confirm that the official report is for that programme.

Choose Chanakya University if you want an official 2026-27 fee for M.Sc Psychology: tuition of ₹1.35 lakh a year, a first-year payable fee of ₹1.40 lakh, and a two-year total of ₹2.75 lakh. There is no Chanakya M.Sc placement row here.

sections.heading: Fees: official figures and recorded year tuition
paragraphs: Alma Better College has two different recorded year tuitions: ₹1.80 lakh for a one-year M.Sc in Computer Science Software Engineering, and ₹90,000 for a two-year M.Sc in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence. These are recorded year fees, not invented programme totals. Confirm the official circular for the track you want.

Chanakya University's official 2026-27 fee page lists M.Sc Psychology tuition at ₹1.35 lakh a year and a two-year total of ₹2.75 lakh. Registration of ₹5,000 brings the first-year payable amount to ₹1.40 lakh.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Alma Better's recorded 2023 figures are an average package of ₹5 lakh and a highest package of ₹14 lakh, listed against the one-year software-engineering M.Sc. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.
Chanakya University has no M.Sc placement row on this page. Ask the university for its latest official postgraduate report.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Neither side has an entrance exam listed in our records on this page. Postgraduate admissions may use a university test, CUET-PG, or a bachelor's-degree cutoff.
The specialisations differ: software engineering or data science on one side, and psychology on the other. Read each official admissions page for the exact eligibility.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Alma Better College is listed at Residency Road, Bengaluru. Chanakya University is listed at Devanahalli, on the city outskirts.
If commute will decide the choice, visit the teaching location listed on each official page.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: These are not the same M.Sc subject, so the first filter is the specialisation you want, not a single fee or package number.
If you want a 2023 placement record, Alma Better is the side we can quote, after you confirm the official report and the official fee for that track.

If you want an official 2026-27 M.Sc Psychology fee, Chanakya University is the side we can quote, at ₹1.35 lakh tuition a year and a ₹2.75 lakh two-year total, but you must ask for a placement report.
